objective: Phase 1 Foundation & Architecture: cargo workspace, Relm4+GTK4 shell, SQLite store+migrations, keychain, core types, errors, logging, CI

tech_stack.testing: cargo test (unit/integration) + Playwright E2E (later phases); pretty_assertions, rstest, mockall, wiremock

workspace_layout: crates/hypernext-core (shared types: PageDoc, Block, Metadata, errors)
architecture_snapshot.authority_model: Single-process Rust, no IPC, no bindings (ADR 0003)

constraints: Single-process Rust. No IPC, no bindings, no frontend/backend split (ADR 0003)
Keychain-only secrets. No plaintext, no Base64 fallback, no SQLite-based secret store (ADR 0007)
tokio exclusively. No async-std, no smol (ADR 0008)
thiserror for libraries, anyhow for app. Never anyhow::Error from library public API (ADR 0009)
No webview anywhere except raw-mode HTTP tabs (ADR 0001, 0002)
No unwrap() in library code (use ? with proper error type); unwrap() in tests acceptable
No magic values: use const for limits, timeouts
No SELECT *: explicit column lists in every SQL query
TDD-first: Red (failing test) -> Green (minimal pass) -> Refactor
All checks must pass before commit: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, cargo deny check
conventions: Conventional Commits: feat(phase-1):, fix(phase-1):, test(phase-1):, docs(phase-1):, chore(phase-1):, refactor(phase-1):, perf(phase-1):
Worklog: append to worklog.md (repo root) after every Task ID
Scripts saved to scripts/ before execution (no heredocs)
Every crate stub starts with #[cfg(test)] mod tests { #[test] fn it_works() { assert!(true); } }
prior_decisions: Platform webviews via embedded widget; Servo deferred (ADR 0002)
Unit + integration + E2E layers, coverage gates (ADR 0005)
Direct crates.io deps for 10 smolnet protocol crates, pinned in lockfile (ADR 0006)
keyring crate; no plaintext fallback ever (ADR 0007)
thiserror for library errors, anyhow for app-level (ADR 0009)
Conventional commits, GitHub Actions matrix, no --no-verify (ADR 0010)

key_risks: R1: GTK4 runtime bundling on macOS fragile / 50MB+ binary -> spike week 1; if gvsbuild >100MB, switch to GTK3 or Iced
R2: rusqlite bundled + modernsqlite + sqlite-vec features conflict -> verify week 2; fallback sqlx or hand-roll sqlite-vec loading
R3: Relm4 macro compilation errors opaque -> maintain relm4-debugging.md notes
R4: keyring prompts macOS keychain unlock on first run, breaking CI -> security unlock-keychain in CI
R5: Workspace dep pinning conflicts (reqwest + tokio version skew) -> cargo tree -d audit week 4
R6: No AI agent has shipped production Relm4 app -> Phase 1 highest-risk; read every Relm4 example; update phase doc when API doesn't match

reuse_notes: Original Bean (Wails) codebase is reference material only - no code carries over
Consult upstream Bean for prior art: internal/protocol/types.go, internal/store/db.go, internal/errors/errors.go, internal/protocol/dispatch.go
